now.title: Thor: Ragnarok
now.text: Hela raises Fenris from the dead, and the Hulk wrestles it off the Rainbow Bridge into the sea.
cases: ST-057 Hela's Conquest of Asgard (Thor: Ragnarok)

proposed.text: Hela raises Fenris from the dead, and the Hulk fights it into the sea below the Rainbow Bridge, then knocks it over the edge of Asgard to its death.

changes.evidence: In Thor: Ragnarok, after Hulk and Fenris fall into the water, Hulk punches Fenris off, sending the wolf falling down the waterfall off the edge of Asgard into the void below; Fandom lists Fenris as Deceased (Late 2017), and Asgard is then destroyed by Surtur. 'At large' does not match where the film leaves it.
